function: above_phy: MARL learns data partitioning (task offloading), CPU-frequency allocation and routing of federated-learning model packets over laser inter-satellite links, not a physical-layer function (p. 8-9).
notes: Excluded as above_phy. The proposed TEMH-PPO MARL is used 'to optimize task partitioning, resource allocation, and aggregation transmission as a unified end-to-end problem' (p. 8). The partitioning agent sets each client's 'data proportions for training' (p. 8), the allocation agent 'allocates computational resources and energy by adjusting the processing frequency' (p. 8), and the transmission agent 'makes decisions on routing paths and whether to initiate aggregation' (p. 9): task offloading, edge computing and routing decisions. The 'resource allocation' is CPU frequency, not radio resources; ISL transmit power is fixed ('the transmit power is a constant value Pv', p. 5) and node bandwidths are randomly sampled and fixed (p. 4), so no link power, radio resource or beam is learned and the satellite exception does not apply. FL aggregation is digital (model packets routed over laser ISLs and averaged at nodes, eq. 25, p. 7; p. 9), not over-the-air, so it would also be outside area 7 (function), but above_phy comes first in the order. PDF matches the DOI (title and DOI on p. 1).
